description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the "Number of tokens" and the "Macro-F1 Score (%)" for two different configurations. The x-axis represents the "Number of tokens" on a linear scale, with data points ranging from 0.5 to 1.5 and major tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2 from 0.6 to 1.4. The y-axis represents the "Macro-F1 Score (%)" on a linear scale, with values ranging from approximately 47 to 59 and major tick marks at intervals of 2 from 48 to 58. The plot features two solid lines with circular markers, both surrounded by shaded bands. The reddish-brown line, labeled "MATTER (ours)", begins at x=0.5 with a y-value of approximately 55.1, dips slightly to 54.3 at x=0.7, and then rises to a local peak of 57.0 at x=0.8. After a slight dip to 56.3 at x=0.9, it reaches its highest peak of 57.9 at x=1.0. From there, it generally declines, reaching 52.6 at x=1.3, briefly rising to 53.5 at x=1.4, and ending at 50.9 at x=1.5. The dark purple line, labeled "w/o material information", starts at x=0.5 with a y-value of 52.5, remains steady to x=0.6 (y=52.6), and rises to its peak of 54.1 at x=0.7. Following this peak, the line exhibits a gradual decline, passing through 53.3 at x=0.8 and x=0.9, down to 51.7 at x=1.3. It then experiences a brief increase to 53.3 at x=1.4 before dropping sharply to end at 47.9 at x=1.5.
